title: Non-Destructive, Depth-Resolved Imaging of Polar Domains in Multiferroic Heterostructures with Multi-Modal Electron Microscopy
content: Recent discoveries have identified polar textures such as polar vortices, skyrmions, and complex domain patterns, all of which are nanoscale objects. These emergent polar states arise from the intricate interplay of elastic, electrostatic and gradient energies, making them highly sensitive to changes in boundary conditions. Such nanoscale polar textures are believed to underlie many of the unique functional properties observed in ferroelectrics, including chiralities and negative capacitance [1,2].
